verdict.reasons: Core rejection: primary Persian product name on the carton displays a clear typographical/letter-order error ("ایکگسترفراپارسیان" instead of the approved "آبگسترفراپارسیان"), which constitutes a core text/branding defect under the rules. The English sleeve caption ("Drip Irrigation Tape"), main AFP wordmark, blue water-drop symbol, and the required "AFP | 09134922013" watermark are all correctly integrated, and the installed drip-tape laterals with neutral seedlings provide valid agronomic evidence. No people, geometry, layout, or mixed-family issues are present.

focused_physical_review.reason: The black drip tape (irrigation line) is clearly visible touching the left-side corner of the package's base and continuing behind the carton on the same axis. Because the line intersects the package footprint and the gap behind the base is obscured by the line passing over/under the soil, a broad uninterrupted soil gap is not visible.

acceptance_warnings: Independent physical condition not met: clear_soil_gap
Independent physical condition not met: line_touches_or_crosses_package
